start.caption: Describe the video you want in the prompt box on Create.
Pick its length and size. The credits it costs show as you type.
The editor opens and makes your reference video. It names the project for you.

templates.caption: Scroll to Start with templates and pick one. Filter by industry or size.
Try its variations, then click Use template.
A new project opens with everything already made. Change anything you like.

assets.caption: Every video you generate is kept in Assets. Open one.
Click Use in Flicks to start a new project with it as the reference video.

variations.caption: Below the canvas: the reference video, then your variations. Click + to add one.
Describe how it differs, like “the same scene, in black lenses”, then Generate.
Each variation costs credits and takes a moment. You can keep working meanwhile.
It generates in the strip. Make 2 to 5 variations; you need 2 to export.

starting.caption: Hover a variation and click the play button to make it the one viewers see first.
A solid play button marks the starting variation.

design.caption: Open Text in the left rail.
Pick a style to add it to the canvas.
Drag to move, use the handles to resize, and style it from the toolbar. It shows on every variation.

links.caption: Select a button on the canvas.
Click the link icon in its toolbar.
Paste a link, or link a feed so each variation goes somewhere different.

feeds.caption: Open Feeds in the left rail. A feed is a value each variation sets for itself.
Add one with +, or open one. Here, @price.
Fill its value for each variation. Link it to text or a button from their toolbar.
Switch variation: the text shows that variation’s value.

thumbnails.caption: Select the thumbnail strip on the canvas. Viewers tap it to switch variations.
Pick a thumbnail, then upload an image for that variation from the toolbar.
Every included variation needs one before you export.

preview.caption: Switch to Preview at the top.
It plays as viewers get it. Tap the thumbnails to switch, try the buttons. Switch back to Design to edit.

versions.caption: Open the file menu next to the project name.
Choose Version history. Save as template is here too.
Versions save as you work; exports are marked. Restore any of them.

export.caption: Click Export at the top right.
Name the Flick (it starts with the project name) and click Export.
Its page opens and it prepares in the background. You can leave and come back.
Ready: share the link, add it to placements and embeds, and see its views.

remix.caption: Flicks don’t change once made. Open one from Flicks.
Click Remix to start a new project from it. The Flick, its link and placements stay as they are.

link.caption: Copy the link from its Flick page, or open it.
Edit link changes its ending and how it looks when shared: image, title and description.

embeds.caption: On a Flick’s page, click Add to embed.
Put it in an embed of its size, or make a new one. Embeds are free.
All your embeds are in Embeds. Open one.
Copy its code into your website or app once. Replace the Flick any time; the code stays the same.

ads.caption: Campaigns hold placements. Open a campaign, or make a new one.
A placement is a fixed-size slot. Open one, or add a placement.
Its page shows the Flick in it, its numbers and history. Replace the Flick any time.

tags.caption: Choose your ad platform. Not listed? Pick Other and type its name.
Choose the format: VAST 4.2, SIMID or MRAID 3.0.
Copy the tag into your ad platform. It stays the same when you replace the Flick.

balance.caption: Ad Balance pays for impressions, per 1,000, at the CPM of the viewer’s country.
Add funds from $100. Tags show once funds are in; if the balance runs negative, ads keep running and the next top-up settles it.

credits.caption: Credits pay for generating videos. Get more any time from the sidebar.
